# Third-party reference material (not part of the repository)

This folder is git-ignored. It contains images and PDFs that were published by other
parties, kept locally for reference while working on the firmware. **No license is
stated on any of them**, so they must not be committed or redistributed without
permission from their owners. The README links to the originals instead.

| File | Source | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Blokschema_960.jpg | https://wiki.deomgevingsmonitor.nl/index.php/Blokschema | © KITT Engineering (block diagram Rev 5.0) |
| Functioneel_640.jpg | https://wiki.deomgevingsmonitor.nl/index.php/Functionele_Beschrijving | KITT Engineering |
| UserInterface_480.jpg, OmgevingsmonitorButtons.jpg | https://wiki.deomgevingsmonitor.nl/ | wiki contributors |
| Modificatie.jpg, Microfoon_480.jpg, Weighting_480.jpg, SGP40_480.jpg, VOC_Index_640.jpg, DutyCycle_640.jpg | https://wiki.deomgevingsmonitor.nl/index.php/Special:ListFiles | wiki contributors |
| Stappenplan-montage_WoTS_Gadget2024.pdf, ENG_step-by-step_montage_WoTS_Gadget2024.pdf | https://fhi.nl/ (assembly guides) | FHI |
| etotaal_header.jpg | https://etotaal.nl/achtergrond/beursgadget-de-omgevingsmonitor/ | Elektronica Totaal |

No schematic or PCB layout has been published. According to the etotaal article, it was
available on request after the WoTS 2024 fair. Asking KITT Engineering for permission
to include the block diagram and schematic would be the way to get them into the repo.
